caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a decanter with a stopper, centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The decanter is rendered in shades of red and pink, with darker red and maroon lines outlining the edges and contours, while lighter pink and white highlights suggest glass reflection and transparency. The decanter has a faceted, geometric design with vertical ridges running from the body to the neck and stopper. The body is bulbous and tapers upward to a narrower neck, transitioning into a multi-tiered stopper that is also faceted and widens at the top. The base of the decanter and the edges of the stopper are depicted using subtle white and light gray shading to indicate thickness and transparency of the glass. The lower right corner of the drawing shows the name "JANET RIZA" in small, capitalized letters.
title: Carafe
